events.content: Nate: Hey Joanna! Long time no see! What's up? Anything fun going on?
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Hey Nate! Long time no see! I've been working on a project lately - it's been pretty cool. What about you - any fun projects or hobbies?
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Hey Joanna! That's cool! I won my first video game tournament last week - so exciting!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Wow Nate! Congrats on winning! Tell me more - what game was it?
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Thanks! it's a team shooter game.
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Wow, great job! What was is called?
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: The game was called Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, and me and my team had a blast to the very end!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Cool, Nate! Sounds like a fun experience, even if I'm not into games.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: It was! How about you? Do you have any hobbies you love?
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Yeah! Besides writing, I also enjoy reading, watching movies, and exploring nature. Anything else you enjoy doing, Nate?
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Playing video games and watching movies are my main hobbies.
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Cool, Nate! So we both have similar interests. What type of movies do you like best?
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: I love action and sci-fi movies, the effects are so cool! What about you, what's your favorite genre?
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: I'm all about dramas and romcoms. I love getting immersed in the feelings and plots.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Wow, movies can be so powerful! Do you have any recommendations for me?
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: [Image: a photo of a poster of a man and a woman sitting on a bench] Yeah, totally! Have you seen this romantic drama that's all about memory and relationships? It's such a good one.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Oh cool! I might check that one out some time soon! I do love watching classics.
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: [Image: a photo of a dvd on a table with a blurry background] Yep, that movie is awesome. I first watched it around 3 years ago. I even went out and got a physical copy!
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Sounds cool! Have you seen it a lot? sounds like you know the movie well!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: A few times. It's one of my favorites! I really like the idea and the acting.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Cool! I'll definitely check it out. Thanks for the recommendation!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: No problem, Nate! Let me know if you like it!
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Joanna: Hey Nate! Haven't talked in a few days. Crazy things happened to me!
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Hi Joanna! Long time no see! What's been going on? You sound excited!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: [Image: a photography of a book with a page of text on it] Woo! I finally finished my first full screenplay and printed it last Friday. I've been working on for a while, such a relief to have it all done!
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Wow, that sounds awesome! What's it about? Glad it's all down!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Thanks, Nate! It's a mix of drama and romance!
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Wow, that's amazing! How do you feel now that it's finished? Do you have any new plans for it?
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Woohoo, Nate! I'm feeling a rollercoaster of emotions - relief, excitement, some anxiety - over finishing this project. Now I'm gonna submit it to some film festivals and (hopefully) get producers and directors to check it out. Here's hoping!
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Congrats, Joanna! That sounds like a wild experience. Rock on and I hope they love it!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Thanks Nate! A mix of emotions for sure. Hopefully, it leads to positive feedback and new opportunities.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: [Image: a photography of a turtle and a turtleling sitting on a rock] Yeah, for sure. Hoping for the best! I like having some of these little ones around to keep me calm when things are super important and I'm nervous.
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Awww! How long have you had them?
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: I've had them for 3 years now and they bring me tons of joy!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: They sure lookl like they do! Adorable!
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Thanks! The turtles might be small, but both sure have big personalities. I really reccomend having something like these little guys for times of stress.
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Good idea, Nate! I'll think about it and maybe get pets of my own soon if I can find any I'm not allergic to. Have you been up to anything recently?
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Yeah actually! I start to hang out with some people outside of my circle at the tournament. They're pretty cool!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Oh? That sounds sweet! Is it a weird relationship with them being competitors and all?
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Oh, kind of. Some people are more competitive then others, so I tend to just stick around the more chill people here.
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: That makes sense! Are you gonna cheer them on even if you lose?
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Absolutely! I don't expect to win big here, I just like playing for fun!  You mentioned you were allergic to pets earlier, how bad is it?
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Oh, its really bad. My face gets all puffy and itchy when I'm around certain animals, so I've always just stayed away.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Sorry to hear that. Allergies can be tough. What specifically are you allergic to?
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: I'm allergic to most reptiles and animals with fur. It can be a bit of a drag, but I find other ways to be happy.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Awesome! There are lots of things that can bring you joy without pets. What else brings you joy?
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Writing and hanging with friends! That way I can express myself through stories, or just have a good time with people.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: That's great to hear! Those are both great things. I'm glad to hear you've got other things to help you get through times of axiousness despite not being able to have animals!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Writing helps me create wild worlds with awesome characters. Plus, it's a great way to express my feelings. I can't imagine life without it.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Wow, Joanna, that sounds amazing! Keep doing what you love!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Thanks, Nate! I'll definitely keep pursuing my passion for writing. It means a lot.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Joanna: Hey Nate, long time no see! The screenplay I sent in to the film festival has been on my mind all day everyday. I keep bouncing between crazy emotions like relief, excitement and worry! Fingers crossed a producer or director falls in love with it and it ends up on the big screen - that would be awesome!
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Hey Joanna! It is a big deal! I'm sure its been a wild ride. Sending some positive vibes and hoping someone likes it enough to get it on the big screen - that would be awesome!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Thanks Nate, your support really means a lot. I put a lot of effort into it and I'm crossing my fingers. What about you? Anything new and exciting happening in your life?
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: [Image: a photo of a bowl of ice cream with a spoon in it] Thanks, Joanna. Not much has changed for me, but I just discovered that I can make coconut milk icecream and gave it a try. It was actually pretty good, so I'm proud of myself.
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Looks delish! Glad you tried something new and it went well. What did you think of it?
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Super good! It was rich and creamy - might be my new favorite snack!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Great! I love when you try something new and it actually works out. Will you give it another go?
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Yep, it could be fun! I'm looking forward to trying out different flavors and toppings.
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Yum! Sounds great. Got any favorite flavors for dairy-free desserts?
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: I love coconut milk, but I also enjoy chocolate and mixed berry flavors.
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: [Image: a photo of a piece of cake with berries on a plate] Wow, those sound great! Who can say no to chocolate and berries? I'm tempted to try dairy-free flavors now!
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Well I also made a dairy-free chocolate cake with berries on it the other day, maybe you would like that!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Wow! That sounds yummy! You're so talented. Thanks for sharing your amazing creations! I should really try making one or just pay you a visit and try one for myself!
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: I couldn't agree more! It's always fun experimenting in the kitchen.
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: I can tell! Your cooking skills are awesome. Seen any good movies lately?
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Not recently. Any good ones you'd recommend?
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: I just watched "Little Women" and it was amazing! It's a great story about sisterhood, love, and reaching for your dreams. Definitely a must-see!
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Oh, that sounds like a great one! I'll definitely add it to my list. Thanks for the recommendation!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Anytime! I'm always down to give movie reccomendations.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Good to know! I'll be sure to give you a shout whenever I run out of things to watch!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Sounds great! Let me know what you think of it when your done!
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: You bet! You'll be the first to know.
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Awesome! Enjoy yourself!
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: You too, take care!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Later, take care!
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Hey Joanna! Sorry I haven't been around. I made my friend some ice cream and they loved it!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: No worries, Nate! Glad to hear it. What flavor did you make?
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: [Image: a photo of a person holding a chocolate and vanilla ice cream cone] I whipped up some chocolate and vanilla swirl.
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: That looks delicious! Unfortunately, I can't have dairy, so no ice cream for me. Do you happen to have a dairy-free recipe that I could try?
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Sure, I know one recipe using coconut milk. Would you like me to send it to you?
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Yeah, definitely! I'm keen to try your recipe. Always up for something sweet.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Cool, I'll do that. I'm all about these desserts, let me know what you think!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Definitely keeping you posted! Love your creations!
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Thanks, Joanna! It means a lot that you enjoy the desserts I bake.
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Yeah Nate, your cooking is amazing! I can't stop thinking about the screenplay, so I just started writing another one while I wait to hear back about how the first one did.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: I hear that, taking your mind of something like that is very challenging. What's the new one about?
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: It's about a thirty year old woman on a journey of self-discovery after a loss. Somewhat similar to the last one, but hey, that's just the kind of thing I'm inspired to write about!
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Interesting! That's a deep topic. Love to hear more about it.
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Thanks, Nate! It's my own story. The main character is dealing with some tough stuff: loss and trying to figure out who they are. They take a road trip to heal and grow.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Wow, Joanna, that sounds awesome. I love stories that tackle important issues. What inspired you to this one?
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Thanks, Nate! It was inspired by personal experiences and my own journey of self-discovery.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Wow, Joanna, that takes guts! I can't wait to see it all come together. I'm also pumped to see how your first one will do!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Appreciate your support. Hoping my screenplay gets noticed and makes it to the screen. Fingers crossed!
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Crossing my fingers for you! Hope your screenplay finds a fan and is given its due. Good luck!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Hey Nate, it's been a minute! I wrapped up my second script, and the feels have been wild. Sometimes I'm so relieved, but other times I just feel anxious about what comes next. It's a mix of excitement and terror, thinking about my work getting noticed and hitting the big screen.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Hey Joanna! Awesome to hear from you! Congrats on wrapping up a second one! All that hard work and dedication will definitely shine through and get noticed, no doubt. Hope you've been able to take some time to relax after everything!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Thanks Nate! It's been a wild ride. I've been decompressing, but it's hard to switch off. There's always this tug-of-war of hope and doubt.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: [Image: a photography of two tortoises laying on the ground in a jungle] It's normal to have doubts, but you've worked hard and put tons of passion into it. Believe in yourself and things will work out. Here, look at this cute pic - walking them always reminds me to enjoy the small stuff!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: That pic's adorable! They always look so relaxed outside. What made you choose them as pets?
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: [Image: a photography of three turtles sitting on rocks in a pond] I'm drawn to turtles. They're unique and their slow pace is a nice change from the rush of life. They're also low-maintenance and calming. Check out this moment I snapped!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: They look so peaceful! It's amazing how these creatures bring so much calm and joy. Is taking care of them tough?
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: No, not really. Just keep their area clean, feed them properly, and make sure they get enough light. It's actually kind of fun.
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Sounds great! Having pets must be a wonderful experience.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Pets definitely bring tons of joy. They are always there for us and they're so cute! Relaxing with them is a great way to chill.
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: I wish I wasn't allergic! I would get two turtles today if I could! I found out recently I'm allergic to cockroaches as well, so who knows if I'll ever get a pet.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Sorry! Maybe there are other animals you could consider! In the meantime though, I'll be sure to send you pics of my turtles so you can still watch them grow without getting too close.
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Great idea! I'm already really invested in those little guys!
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Pets really seem to do that to everyone don't they! So, what about your script now? Any ideas for the next steps?
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: I've been doing my fair share of research and networking non-stop for it. It's tough, but I'm determined to make it happen.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Great idea! that should hopefully get some more eyes on it. Keep up the hard work!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Thanks so much, Nate! Your support means a lot. I'll keep working at it and hopefully the next steps will become clearer soon.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Just make sure you don't quit - the path forward will show up soon. You got this!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: Appreciated! I think just having someone to support me throughout the whole process is such a blessing. It gives me the motivation to keep pushing forward.
events.speaker: Joanna

events.content: Nate: Glad to hear my support makes a difference, Joanna. I'm here for you!
events.speaker: Nate

events.content: Joanna: [Image: a photo of a cinema ticket on a chair] Always good to hear! See you later!
events.speaker: Joanna
